data.name: AWSAR India
data.intro: AWSAR India works with children, women, youth, and communities across education, health, livelihoods, research — building a more equitable society since 2001.
data.storyLead: Rooted in lived experience. Built on the conviction that opportunity — awsar — is what every person needs and deserves.
story: AWSAR starts from a simple observation: talent is found everywhere, but opportunity is not.
data.vision: An inclusive, equitable society built on democratic values, sustainable livelihoods, and better quality of life for all.
data.mission: Create opportunities for holistic development by building capacity, generating knowledge, and providing professional services for communities and institutions working with marginalised groups.

impact.label: Trees planted for environmental sustainability across rural communities
